MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 34
   C. 22
   D. 17

2. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   C. 37
   D. 31.7

   B. 21
   C. 90
   D. 30

   B. 11
   C. 10
   D. 100

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)

   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   D. 37

   D. 33

15. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 10
   D. 40.5

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)

   A. 15
   B. 22
   C. 30

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 2

24. Solve for x: x + 5 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 11
   D. 7

25. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)

26. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)

   A. 40

   C. 10
   D. 4

30. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 11
